title: Step 2 - Using Pandas iloc for Feature Selection in ML Data Preprocessing

cues.en: -: All right, so let's do this. Starting with X.
cues.zh: 好，先從 X 開始。

cues.en: So how are we going to create X?
cues.zh: 要如何建立 X 呢？

cues.en: Basically, that's simple.
cues.zh: 其實很簡單。

cues.en: We have our data set containing exactly all this, all these columns.
cues.zh: 目前的 dataset 包含這裡的所有欄位。

cues.en: And in order to create X, well, we simply have to take the three first columns of this data set because you know X will be exactly all these values here, with the three first columns.
cues.zh: 要建立 X，只要取出資料集的前三欄，因為 X 就是這三欄的所有數值。

cues.en: And so what we're simply going to do is play with the indexes to collect, indeed, the indexes of these three first columns, basically of the columns of all the columns of the data set,
cues.zh: 所以我們要利用索引，取出前三欄，也就是資料集的全部欄位，

cues.en: except the last one.
cues.zh: 除了最後一欄。

cues.en: So let's do this. Let me show you how to do this.
cues.zh: 現在示範怎麼做。

cues.en: First, what you're gonna do is take your data set, that exact same variable which you created in this first line of code here, okay?
cues.zh: 首先取出 dataset，就是第一行程式建立的同一個變數。

cues.en: Data set.
cues.zh: dataset。

cues.en: Then from this data set, and I'm adding a dot here because we're about to use a function, one of the attribute functions of a Pandas data frame and that function is ilock.
cues.zh: 在 dataset 後面加一個句點，因為要使用 pandas DataFrame 的索引屬性 iloc。

cues.en: And what will it allow us to do?
cues.zh: 它能做什麼？

cues.en: Well as you can see, ilock here stands for locate indexes and therefore what this function will do is it will take the indexes of the columns
cues.zh: iloc 用來根據位置索引存取資料，因此可以取得

cues.en: we want to extract from the data set.
cues.zh: 想從資料集取出的欄位索引。

cues.en: Not only the indexes of the columns but also the indexes of the rows.
cues.zh: 不只有欄的索引，也可以指定列的索引。

cues.en: And actually we have to start here with the rows.
cues.zh: 而且這裡必須先寫列。

cues.en: We can specify the rows that we want to get and put into X.
cues.zh: 指定哪些資料列要放入 X。

cues.en: And of course these are all the rows.
cues.zh: 當然，我們要的是全部資料列。

cues.en: We want to get all the rows into X.
cues.zh: X 裡要保留所有列。

cues.en: We only want to take the first columns, what we want to keep all the rows.
cues.zh: 只篩選前面的欄位，列則全部保留。

cues.en: And the trick to take all the rows, whatever data set you have, with whatever number of rows is to add here a column.
cues.zh: 不管資料集有多少列，要選取全部列的技巧，就是在這裡寫一個冒號。

cues.en: Why is that? Because a column in Python means a range.
cues.zh: 為什麼？因為 Python 的冒號代表一個範圍。

cues.en: And when we specify a range without the lower bound and neither the upper bound, that means in Python that we're taking everything in the range, therefore here's all the rows.
cues.zh: 如果範圍沒有指定下界，也沒有指定上界，在 Python 中就表示取出整個範圍，也就是所有列。

cues.en: So that's a trick to take all the rows and you will aways have to take all the rows so here you won't have anything to change.
cues.zh: 這就是選取所有列的技巧，而且之後也都要保留所有列，所以這裡不用改。

cues.en: Now we have to specify which columns we wanna select with the indexes and to separate the rows that we just took from the columns, we need here to add a comma,
cues.zh: 接著用索引指定要哪些欄，而列與欄之間，要用逗號分隔，

cues.en: and now we can take care of the columns.
cues.zh: 現在就能處理欄位。

cues.en: All right, so now I'm gonna show you a trick in order to take all the columns except the last one, because indeed, as I told you, most of the data sets you will use
cues.zh: 接下來示範如何取出除了最後一欄以外的所有欄位。如前所述，大多數

cues.en: to train your machinery models will have first the features in the first columns and last the dependent variable vector in the last column.
cues.zh: 訓練資料集的前面欄位是特徵，最後一欄是依變數向量。

cues.en: So now we're gonna use a trick so that we can take automatically, regardless of the number of columns in your data set, all the columns except the last one.
cues.zh: 不論資料集有多少個欄位，我們都能用這個技巧，自動取出最後一欄以外的所有欄位。

cues.en: Because all the columns except the last one are exactly the matrix of features.
cues.zh: 因為，這些欄位剛好就是特徵矩陣。

cues.en: And the trick to do that is to add a new range here which this time will be : -1.
cues.zh: 做法是在這裡加入另一個範圍，這次是 :-1。

cues.en: So what does it mean?
cues.zh: 這代表什麼？

cues.en: Well, as we said, the : here means the range, we know we're taking a range.
cues.zh: 如前所述，冒號表示我們要取一個範圍。

cues.en: Here on the left, we have nothing.
cues.zh: 左邊沒有填數值。

cues.en: That means that we're taking the first index, the index zero, because indexes in Python start at zero.
cues.zh: 代表從第一個索引，也就是 0 開始，因為 Python 的索引從 0 起算。

cues.en: And then we're going up to minus one.
cues.zh: 接著到 -1 為止。

cues.en: So what does this minus one mean?
cues.zh: 那 -1 又代表什麼？

cues.en: Well, minus one means here, the last column.
cues.zh: 這裡的 -1 代表最後一欄。

cues.en: Minus one in Python means the index of the last column.
cues.zh: 在 Python 中，-1 就是最後一欄的索引。

cues.en: However, and that's a very important principle in Python which you must absolutely know, a range in Python includes the lower bound therefore we're including here the lower bound zero
cues.zh: 但 Python 有一個務必知道的重要原則：範圍包含下界，所以這裡包含下界 0，

cues.en: the index zero, but excludes the upper bound.
cues.zh: 也就是索引 0，但不包含上界。

cues.en: And therefore here we're excluding this index minus one meaning the index of the last column.
cues.zh: 因此，這裡會排除索引 -1，也就是最後一欄。

cues.en: And therefore what this will do is it will take all the columns, excluding the last one.
cues.zh: 所以這段程式會取出所有欄位，但不包含最後一欄。

cues.en: And that's exactly what we want for our matrix of features X.
cues.zh: 這正是特徵矩陣 X 所需要的內容。

cues.en: So voila, there you go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: Now you just collected the right indexes to create your matrix of features X.
cues.zh: 現在已取得建立特徵矩陣 X 所需的正確索引。

cues.en: And the beauty of this is that you won't have anything to change when creating the future matrices of features X of your future data sets.
cues.zh: 更棒的是，以後對其他資料集建立特徵矩陣時，這段程式完全不用更動。

cues.en: But make sure that your future data sets indeed have the features in the first columns and the dependent variable vector in the last column, okay?
cues.zh: 但請確認，資料集確實把特徵放在前面的欄位，依變數向量放在最後一欄。

cues.en: Perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: So in order to finish this line of code we just need to add here .values.
cues.zh: 最後只需要接上 .values，就完成這一行程式。

cues.en: And this just means that we're taking indeed all the values and all the rows of this data set and in all the columns except the last one of this data set.
cues.zh: 這表示取得資料集所有列，以及最後一欄以外全部欄位中的實際數值。

cues.en: Perfect. So now you're learning a lot.
cues.zh: 很好，你已經學到很多了。

cues.en: Don't worry if this feels a bit overwhelming at the beginning, I promise you that we will use this trick many, many times.
cues.zh: 如果一開始覺得資訊太多，不用擔心，我保證後面會反覆使用這個技巧。

cues.en: So you will just soon be so familiar with it and master it like a pro.
cues.zh: 很快你就會非常熟悉，像專家一樣掌握它。
